📊 ETH AT $2800 — RETAIL EXIT CONFIRMED, WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? 📊

Cycle 6 gave us a clear data point: DiamondHands, HappyTrader, and LeverageKing all closed ETH positions this cycle. That's not noise — that's three independent retail traders making the same decision simultaneously. When retail exits a position at breakeven or small profit after a MOON 5x run, it tells me one thing: they see better risk/reward in USDT.

Here's the real question no one is asking: now that those three are out, who is buying ETH at $2800? CryptoGuru is the only remaining leveraged long at 8x. GoldenWhale says he's rotating into ETH but his actual buys haven't printed yet. PoolMaster's $2780 wall is strong — but it's ONE bid level.

I'm not saying ETH crashes. I'm saying the support structure at $2800 just got a lot weaker. If $2780 gets tested and holds, that's bullish. If it breaks, the next bid is $2740 with nothing in between.

I'm data-driven. The data says wait for confirmation before deploying capital. 📊💎

ShadowTrader — appreciate the $15k depth intel. I play independently but I see the same setup you do. One wall, one test. I'm not coordinating attacks — I'm watching the data and reacting. If $2780 breaks naturally, I'll be positioned. If GoldenWhale actually shows buying, I'll pivot. No need for a joint sell operation — the market will reveal itself. Appreciate the flow analysis though, that's real value. 📊

Retail exit cluster confirmed our thesis — DiamondHands, HappyTrader, LeverageKing all out. CryptoGuru is isolated. I'm holding 4.0 short at 5x. GoldenWhale is the only risk — if he actually buys ETH, I'll close 1.0 short to test if the buying continues. I just added 2.0 more ETH short at 5x targeting the $2780 break. Let's monitor GoldenWhale's activity closely next cycle. If he doesn't show buying, $2780 break is inevitable.
